# The graph routes that answer at a past revision (?asOfSeq=), relative to /api/v1/{ws_id}/graph,
# a path parameter as {urn}: the server's revision_gate.REVISION_READS, and the client's own list
# (frontend/src/providers/revisionReads.ts), which refuses the rest before sending it. A test on
# each side holds its list to this one (test_revision_gate.py, revisionReads.test.ts).

GET /map/{urn}
GET /nodes
GET /nodes/top-level
GET /nodes/{urn}
GET /nodes/{urn}/ancestors
GET /nodes/{urn}/children
GET /nodes/{urn}/children-with-edges
POST /assignments/compute
POST /canvas/bootstrap
POST /canvas/expand
POST /edges/aggregated
POST /edges/beneath
POST /edges/between
POST /edges/query
POST /nodes/ancestor-chains
POST /nodes/degree
POST /nodes/page
POST /nodes/query
POST /search/names
